Meena, a woman from a broken family and Muthukumar, a man with a troubled past, face various difficulties in their marriage challenged by their difficult backgrounds and personal struggles.
The bond of Kanmani and Vennila, two close friends, undergoes a tough trial when they both fall in love with the same person.
Ilamathi, a courageous and kind-hearted girl, gets caught in the middle of chaos when a daring cop and a reckless goon express their affection towards her.

programs.showName: Suttum Vizhi Sudare Oru Chinanjiru Kuyilin Kadhai
programs.description: Bringing the best in television.
A woman's aspiration to study medicine is obstructed by societal traditions after her betrothal to a wealthy patriarch's son.
Resort
A young woman takes good care of her brothers-in-law and manages the household affairs. However, things take a turn when the family suddenly faces difficult situations.
Karikalan manages his house with total dominance. However, the father's strictly governed life starts to fracture as his sons' secret romances emerge.
The Kandhasamys manage a modest vegetarian mess. When Indira, a young, modern woman, joins the family, old ways are tested. Will the household evolve together or grow apart?
Siblings Mayandi and Pechi become bitter enemies after a deep rift divides their family. However, things take a turn when they stage a marriage between their children as an act of revenge.
Married into a male-dominated household, two polar opposites, a conventional woman and a modern one, challenge the norms.
